TC-11/S03.runNote: Intermittent, not counted: in 4 Save Notes today (TC-20/S17 NH during the 14:4x overload; TC-21/S17 Hospital at 16:55; TC-11/S03 NH at 16:59 and 17:02 JST) the text was saved but the structured summary never arrived and no error was set within 90 s (preRoundProcessing stuck true, or no notesProcessedAt and no preRoundError); the retries were clean. No aiCallLog row was captured for those attempts, so the cause (model latency vs app) is open; worth watching on dev. Observation, not judged: every entry the Save Note writes ends in a doubled full stop ('…oxygenation.. ⏳ Encounter pending.', '…Continue PT/OT..'): the writers append '.' to a model entry that already ends in one (usePreRoundProcess / useSnfPreRoundProcess).
manualChecklistEn: [TC-11/S03 one step left: rate whether the timeline's trend is clear (T4; Q8 has no written standard, so record only, no Pass/Fail; about 5 minutes, no sign-in needed)]
The date / count / skipped-day / no-duplicate cells are already judged automatically (cells-hospital.json, cells-nursing-home.json).
1. Open evidence/TC-11-S03/hospital-day2-pre-round.png and hospital-day3-pre-round.png; look only at the Hospital Course → Course Timeline cards, not the notes.
2. Open evidence/TC-11-S03/nursing-home-after-visit3-pre-round.png; look only at the three Visit Timeline cards.
3. Answer in one sentence for each: is the trend of this stay clear? (yes / no + one reason); write it into this entry's personRating in results.json.
